Bangladesh Reviews 101 Pacts with India, Citing 'Win-Win' Goal

Bangladesh has initiated a review of 101 existing agreements with India, with the stated objective of ensuring these pacts become 'win-win' for both nations. This move has prompted a strong response from India, which has indicated it will "take all necessary actions." The specific details of the agreements under review and the exact nature of India's planned actions were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
